experiment_kind: CPU synthetic-input eligibility certificate statistics; no GPU execution or timing
source_capture: Original command stdout from this session, losslessly transcribed from ten three-trial batches into thirty seed-labelled JSONL rows; experiment was not rerun for archival.
q_domain: Full E2M1 q=2*value, chosen by quantize_mx; no narrow-alphabet filter
scale_minimum_method: Includes all blocks, including q-zero blocks; more conservative than ignoring q-zero blocks.
energy_method: Exact signed-int64 q^2 per block times 4^(scale-row_min), summed by row, max across rows; safe for K<=16384 and span<=12. Energy not computed when max span>12.
eligibility_comparison: Python unbounded integer product U*V <= 2^48; rounded bound_fraction is display-only.
lambda_range: The observed overall scale ranges imply every row-min pair lambda is in [-126,103]; no per-row lambda metadata was printed by the original experiment.
limitations: Synthetic data only; three seeds per shape/distribution do not estimate real LLM eligibility probability.
No GPU correctness, GPU wrapper, throughput or convergence conclusion.
No clipping, lowered tolerance, or narrowed q alphabet was used to make certificates pass.

primary_sources.used_for: FP16 multiply / FP32 accumulator precision and unspecified accumulation order, rounding, subnormal behavior.
CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F, FP32 output, reduced-precision reduction control, Tensor Core eligibility and SetStream workspace reset.
E2M1 and E8M0 storage formats; project arithmetic and certificate are separately defined.

cpu-certified-distribution.py.role: Standalone faithful reproduction of the original distribution/certificate computation; output reshaped to one trial per line
